column3: The initial or is not expressed.
“For instance” expands for; “law of marriage” replaces law of the husband.
“Died” replaces the passive were put to death.
“Lived according to the flesh” replaces were in the flesh; “bodies” replaces members.
“New way” and “old way” render newness and oldness; “written code” replaces letter.
“And I died” belongs to verse 10 in the Greek numbering.
The initial I died is placed in verse 9; “was meant to bring” supplies a verbal phrase.
“Unspiritual” replaces fleshly; “as a slave” is supplied.
BSB supplies “I cannot carry it out”; the critical text ends abruptly with “but to accomplish the good, not,” while the Textus Receptus adds “I find” (εὑρίσκω).
“This body of death” replaces the body of this death.
